subject.title: Heartbeat sessions report 'assistant turn failed before producing content' on model initialization failure

question: Should heartbeat model-initialization failures get only clearer provider/fallback diagnostics, or should heartbeat add a special retry-on-fallback behavior beyond the existing model fallback chain?
rationale: The diagnostic split is a normal reliability fix, but a heartbeat-specific fallback retry can change provider routing, spend, state updates, and operator expectations, so automation should not choose that policy by itself.

options.title: Classify at the shared failure boundary
options.body: Repair provider/model initialization classification and verify existing configured fallback behavior before adding a heartbeat-only retry path.

options.title: Add heartbeat-specific retry
options.body: Make heartbeat retry once with a configured fallback model, accepting the extra provider-routing and spend behavior as an explicit product choice.

options.title: Keep generic heartbeat failure handling
options.body: Treat this as an external provider/Ollama instability diagnostic only and leave fallback behavior unchanged, keeping the issue open only for better logs if desired.

recommendation.title: Classify at the shared failure boundary
recommendation.body: Repair provider/model initialization classification and verify existing configured fallback behavior before adding a heartbeat-only retry path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent broad runtime/gateway history plus adjacent provider/fallback ownership makes this the best available owner for the product-scope choice.
